localChanges: How to play, on the title screen and in the Game menu, explains your first turns: giving units their orders, founding cities, choosing what they build and ending the turn. It also lists the controls for the device you're on: taps and pressing and holding on a touch screen, or clicks, the mouse wheel and every keyboard shortcut with a mouse. You can switch to the other device's, and the keys shown are always the ones the game uses (closes #1270).
A newcomer is offered it once on the title screen.
